purpose: Local Chromium upload-preparation screening and independent confirmation; synthetic fixtures only, no end-to-end throughput or archive-ratio claim
budget: Baseline, three bounded variants, then one baseline/candidate confirmation pair. No further search after confirmation.
sourceNote: Worker snapshots reproduce each variant; client and codec core are unchanged from baseRevision. Candidate differs from combined screening by an ownership comment only. Served-source hashes are checked against these snapshots.
rights: Project-generated synthetic fixtures only; original holdout labels retained, three extra chunk workloads excluded from codec ratio scoring.

commands.confirm-candidate: node scripts/benchmark-browser.cjs --revision 'b5fe6bb plus combined upload-worker optimization; confirmation' --repetitions 5 > /tmp/secure-transfer-browser-upload-confirm-candidate.json

baseline.method: Actual browser client and native dedicated worker. One warmup per case is excluded from summaries. prepareMs includes worker messaging/cloning; workerMs is reported by the worker. Fixture loading, original-hash checks and Node server decoding/verification are outside the timed preparation. Native worker events are observed to reject silent fallback.
baseline.boundaries: Local browser preparation only: no upload/download throughput, application server, scanner, storage, archive framing, billing, network congestion, target-device acceptance or peak-memory measurement. Encoded body sizes are wire payloads, not complete downloadable archives. Default fixtures are synthetic; existing holdout labels are retained.
